title: A handle table
description:
Give each process a table of handles that point to kernel objects, with access rights.

```
process A opens file "save.dat" for read -> handle 4
handle 4 write -> STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED
duplicate handle 4 -> handle 8 (same object, 2 references)
close 4, close 8 -> object freed
```
hints: `std::shared_ptr` does the reference counting for you here; the kernel does it by hand.
requirements: Objects have a reference count; handles hold an object, an access mask and an index (multiples of 4).
Every use checks the handle exists and has the right access.
The object is freed when the last handle is closed.
stretch: Two processes share an object; closing in one does not free it for the other.
